name: PageControl
description: A dot-based page indicator component for carousels, onboarding flows, and paged content. Renders a row of interactive dots representing pages, with the current page visually highlighted.

notes: Each dot is rendered as a button with role='tab' for screen reader compatibility.
Arrow keys navigate between dots. Home and End jump to first and last dot.
The active dot is visually distinguished via background colour and scale.
Minimum touch target of 44px is maintained on each dot via padding.

numPages.description: Total number of pages (dots) to render.

currentPage.description: Zero-based index of the currently active page.

onChange.description: Called when the user selects a different page dot.

size.description: Size of the dots. 'sm' renders smaller dots; 'md' renders the default size.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the root element.

do: Use for carousel or onboarding step indicators.
Always provide an accessible label via aria-label on the root.
dont: Do not use as a replacement for Pagination with numbered pages.
Do not use for navigation between unrelated content sections — use Tabs instead.
